query:
UPDATE kb_join_requests
                   SET status = $2,
                       reviewed_by_profile_id = $3,
                       reviewed_at = now(),
                       decision_note = $4,
                       updated = now()
                 WHERE requesting_profile_id = $1
                   AND status = 'pending'
                   AND team_id = (SELECT t.id
                                    FROM kb_teams t
                                    JOIN kb_system_settings s ON s.gating_team_slug = t.slug
                                   WHERE s.id = 1)
